_meta.notes: Per-indicator metadata for the info-icon in the dashboard UI (Brief 3 F1) and for CSV export provenance (Brief 3 D4). Every indicator carries source, table/measure id, universe, why-it-matters, main limitation, and state + national reference values. ACS reference values are 2020-2024 unless otherwise noted. PLACES reference values are 2024 release, model-based estimates. Values are approximate and intended for interpretation, not for citation without independent verification.

sources.ACS: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates, 2020-2024 release (baseline 2015-2019).
sources.PLACES: CDC, PLACES: Local Data for Better Health, 2024 release. Model-based small-area estimates derived from BRFSS + demographic covariates. NOT comparable across releases.

ACS.note: American Community Survey publishes MOE at 90% confidence. Derive SE = MOE / 1.645 for downstream calculations.

PLACES.note: CDC PLACES publishes 95% credible intervals from a small-area model. These are NOT sampling MOEs and must not be relabeled as such (Brief 3 Amendment B1).

uncertainty_schema.note: Every indicator carries an <indicator>_uncert field on the layer once E2 lands. UI reads this to label the interval type consistently. Never collapse the two into one _moe field.

governance.fair_lending: Indicators in the 'Race, Ethnicity & Language' domain are DESCRIPTIVE CONTEXT ONLY. They MUST NOT enter any composite score, ranking, or best/worst determination. See standing guardrail #1.
governance.no_investment_advice: Every scoring, ranking, and designation surface must carry a notice that this is descriptive research output and that eligibility must be verified with the administering agency.
governance.composite_allowlist: compositeEligible defaults to true for ACS indicators outside the race/ethnicity/language domain and false for PLACES (per CDC guidance against ranking local areas from modeled estimates). Additions require explicit JHFRC review.

_meta.trend_geography_note: 5-year change (delta) is computed on 2020 census tract geometry. The 2015-2019 ACS baseline (published on 2010 tract vintage) is areally re-projected onto 2020 tract geometry using the Census 2020-to-2010 tract relationship file (population-fraction apportionment for rates, primary-overlap for medians and Gini). PLACES 2019 baseline is treated the same way, and delta is computed against the current PLACES 2024 release on 2020 tract vintage. The pipeline that produced the deltas is tools/harmonize_deltas.py; the crosswalk files live at data/geo/tract_2020_to_2010_rel_st{47,13,01,37}.txt.
_meta.places_trend_caveat: PLACES estimates are model-based (BRFSS + demographic covariates) and CDC's small-area model is re-fit for each release. Delta values between PLACES releases mix real epidemiological change with model refit drift, and the two cannot be separated from the published estimates alone. UI surfaces this caveat wherever a PLACES delta is displayed.

POVERTY_UNIVERSE.label: Population for whom poverty status is determined

POP_5P.label: Population 5 years and over (derived: total - under 5)

HH_WITH_65P.label: Households by presence of persons 65 years and over

OWNER_OCC_WITH_MORTGAGE.label: Owner-occupied housing units with a mortgage where SMOCAPI can be computed (B25091_002E excluding "not computed" B25091_012E)

RENTER_PAYING_RENT_GRAPI_COMPUTED.label: Renter-occupied units paying cash rent where GRAPI can be computed (B25070_001E excluding B25070_011E "not computed")

_meta.universe_recipe_note: Per-indicator universe fields (<indicator>.universe) name the ACS variable or formula that defines the denominator that indicator's rate is calculated against. Used for universe-weighted tract aggregation when a published county estimate is unavailable (task #123). PLACES adult measures use ADULT_POP_18P per CDC methodology.
_meta.aggregation_note: Per-indicator .aggregation controls whether Compare Counties may compute a universe-weighted tract aggregation when the published <CountyValue> is missing. method=universe_weighted means sum(rate x universe) / sum(universe) is defensible; method=not_aggregable means the cell stays blank (typically medians, indices, or indicators without a proper universe recipe). min_coverage is the minimum fraction of a county's tracts that must have both a valid rate and a valid universe for the aggregation to be shown; below that, blank.
_meta.aggregation_governance: Compare Counties tract aggregation is only permitted when BOTH aggregation.method == 'universe_weighted' AND aggregation.validation_status == 'validated'. Indicators whose universe recipe is defensible but whose metric identity has not yet been confirmed against an official ACS county estimate stay 'unresolved' and render blank in Compare Counties. Promote to 'validated' only after tools/validate_aggregation.py confirms a match within tolerance. Rule: having a defensible universe is not permission to aggregate.

pov_below.label: Below Poverty Line (%)
pov_below.why_it_matters: The most common proxy for economic distress in community investment; a foundational input to CRA, CDFI, NMTC and grant scoring.
pov_below.limitation: The federal poverty line is a coarse threshold and does not adjust for local cost of living; underestimates hardship in high-cost metros.

aggregation.reason: Systematic +4-6 pp divergence from official ACS county estimate in every county. Source statistic under verification (S1701 individual poverty vs family poverty vs another construct). Task #123 governance.

hh_snap.label: Households Receiving Food Stamps (%)
hh_snap.why_it_matters: SNAP participation captures material food insecurity better than pure income measures.
hh_snap.limitation: Reflects program uptake; households eligible but not enrolled do not appear here.

hh_pubasst.label: Households Receiving Public Assistance (%)
hh_pubasst.why_it_matters: TANF and equivalent cash-assistance reliance; a signal of the population most exposed to policy shifts.
hh_pubasst.limitation: Small absolute counts in most tracts; high MOE relative to point estimate.

aggregation.reason: Hamilton derived 1.49 matches official 1.50; all other counties 10-20x too high (values look SNAP-like). Upstream source vs join-logic investigation pending (task #127). Task #123 governance.

emp_adults.label: Employment-to-Population Ratio (Age 16+) (%)
emp_adults.why_it_matters: Employment rate on the tract's own denominator, not the labor-force denominator; useful for community-benefit prioritization.
emp_adults.limitation: Point-in-time; does not reflect underemployment or informal work.

not_labor.label: Not in Labor Force (%)
not_labor.why_it_matters: Complements the employment rate; a high share paired with low retirement-age share signals hidden unemployment.
not_labor.limitation: Includes retirees, students, caregivers; interpret alongside age structure.

mhi.label: Median Household Income ($)
mhi.why_it_matters: The single most decision-relevant income measure for lending, siting, and CRA analysis.
mhi.limitation: Median is unstable at small denominators; can shift materially year to year in low-population tracts.

aggregation.reason: Median household income; medians do not aggregate as weighted means of tract rates.

mpci.label: Mean Per Capita Income ($)
mpci.why_it_matters: Per-capita income normalizes for household size differences; use alongside median household income.
mpci.limitation: Mean is pulled by high-income outliers.

gini.label: Gini Index (Income Inequality)
gini.why_it_matters: Within-tract income dispersion; a high Gini in a nominally affluent tract can indicate a distressed subpopulation.
gini.limitation: Tract-level Gini has wide MOEs; treat as a rough band, not a precise value.

aggregation.reason: Gini index measures within-unit inequality; the county Gini is not a weighted mean of tract Ginis.

edu_lths.label: Less than High School Education (%)
edu_lths.why_it_matters: The single most-used education gap indicator; drives workforce and adult-ed programming siting.
edu_lths.limitation: Immigrant-heavy tracts can show elevated values with high correlated foreign-born share.

edu_posths.label: Any Post-High School Education (%)
edu_posths.why_it_matters: Broad indicator of local workforce readiness — sums associate, bachelor's, and graduate degrees.
edu_posths.limitation: Does not distinguish credentials with vs. without labor-market value.

edu_assoc.label: Associate's Degree (%)
edu_assoc.why_it_matters: Community-college attainment; a useful marker for local workforce pipelines.
edu_assoc.limitation: Excludes those who moved on to a bachelor's.

edu_ba.label: Bachelor's Degree (%)
edu_ba.why_it_matters: Standard human-capital indicator; correlates strongly with income and health outcomes at tract scale.
edu_ba.limitation: Not sensitive to STEM-vs-liberal-arts mix or credential quality.

edu_grad.label: Graduate/Professional Degree (%)
edu_grad.why_it_matters: High-skill workforce concentration; a signal of professional-services capacity in an area.
edu_grad.limitation: Tract-level MOEs are wide for low-share tracts.

youth_dis.label: Teens (Ages 16-19) Not in School & Unemployed (%)
youth_dis.why_it_matters: Disconnected-youth indicator; correlates with intergenerational poverty and criminal-justice risk.
youth_dis.limitation: Tiny denominators in many tracts; treat as unstable below n = 30.

any_disab.label: Any Disability (%)
any_disab.why_it_matters: Foundational access indicator; drives ADA, transit, and health-service siting.
any_disab.limitation: Self-reported; captures both severity and cultural reporting differences.

no_insur.label: Uninsured (Ages 18-64) (%)
no_insur.why_it_matters: The most decision-relevant health-access indicator for FQHC, hospital community-benefit, and Medicaid outreach planning.
no_insur.limitation: Point-in-time snapshot; does not reflect coverage churn.

aggregation.reason: Universe requires age 18-64 (or 19-64 per current ACS) civilian noninstitutionalized population; B27001 cannot cleanly express this age band (age 18 is grouped with 6-18). Verify source statistic (S2701 age band) before enabling tract aggregation. Published county_avg remains usable where present.

private_ins.label: Private Insurance (All Ages) (%)
private_ins.why_it_matters: Payer-mix input for hospitals and physician practices considering a site.
private_ins.limitation: Does not distinguish employer-sponsored, individual-market, or exchange coverage.

medicaid.label: Medicaid Coverage (All Ages) (%)
medicaid.why_it_matters: Direct input to safety-net capacity planning; the primary payer for FQHCs and behavioral-health providers.
medicaid.limitation: Tennessee is a non-expansion state; interpret differently from expansion-state values.

hh_diab.label: Diabetes (%)
hh_diab.why_it_matters: Chronic-disease burden signal; drives community health worker, endocrinology, and pharmacy siting.
hh_diab.limitation: Model-based estimate; NOT comparable across PLACES releases.

aggregation.reason: No defensible universe recipe defined; blank when published county value unavailable.

hh_asthma.label: Asthma (%)
hh_asthma.why_it_matters: Environmental-health signal; correlates with housing age and air-quality exposures.
hh_asthma.limitation: Model-based estimate; NOT comparable across PLACES releases.

aggregation.reason: No defensible universe recipe defined; blank when published county value unavailable.

hh_heart.label: Coronary Heart Disease (%)
hh_heart.limitation: Model-based estimate; NOT comparable across PLACES releases.

aggregation.reason: No defensible universe recipe defined; blank when published county value unavailable.

hh_bp.label: High Blood Pressure (%)
hh_bp.why_it_matters: Baseline chronic-disease indicator; large lever for public-health interventions.
hh_bp.limitation: Model-based estimate; NOT comparable across PLACES releases.

aggregation.reason: No defensible universe recipe defined; blank when published county value unavailable.

hh_bpmed.label: Taking Blood Pressure Medication (%)
hh_bpmed.why_it_matters: Treatment-adherence proxy; complements the hypertension prevalence indicator.
hh_bpmed.limitation: Denominator is those with hypertension, not the full adult population.

hh_chol.label: High Cholesterol (%)
hh_chol.why_it_matters: Cardiovascular-risk indicator; correlates with the other cardiometabolic PLACES measures.
hh_chol.limitation: Only counts those screened; underestimates true prevalence.

aggregation.reason: No defensible universe recipe defined; blank when published county value unavailable.

hh_arthr.label: Arthritis (%)
hh_arthr.why_it_matters: Musculoskeletal burden; drives physical-therapy and orthopedic demand.
hh_arthr.limitation: Correlates strongly with age; interpret alongside age structure.

aggregation.reason: No defensible universe recipe defined; blank when published county value unavailable.

hh_copd.label: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) (%)
hh_copd.why_it_matters: Respiratory-care demand; correlates with smoking and occupational exposures.
hh_copd.limitation: Model-based estimate; NOT comparable across PLACES releases.

aggregation.reason: No defensible universe recipe defined; blank when published county value unavailable.

hh_stroke.label: Stroke (%)
hh_stroke.why_it_matters: Cerebrovascular-care demand; correlates with the cardiometabolic cluster.
hh_stroke.limitation: Prevalence, not incidence; captures survivors of stroke events.

aggregation.reason: No defensible universe recipe defined; blank when published county value unavailable.

ph_poor14.label: Poor Physical Health >=14 Days (%)
ph_poor14.why_it_matters: Self-reported burden of physical health; complements clinical-condition prevalence.
ph_poor14.limitation: Self-reported and threshold-sensitive; 14-day cutoff is arbitrary.

aggregation.reason: No defensible universe recipe defined; blank when published county value unavailable.

mh_poor14.label: Poor Mental Health >=14 Days (%)
mh_poor14.why_it_matters: Best available small-area behavioral-health need indicator; drives BH-service siting.
mh_poor14.limitation: Self-reported; the 14-day cutoff and cultural reporting differences both matter.

aggregation.reason: No defensible universe recipe defined; blank when published county value unavailable.

fair_hlth.label: Fair or Poor Self-Reported Health (%)
fair_hlth.why_it_matters: Global health-perception indicator; strong predictor of mortality even after controlling for clinical measures.

aggregation.reason: No defensible universe recipe defined; blank when published county value unavailable.

smoke.label: Smoking (%)
smoke.why_it_matters: Modifiable risk factor with the largest single population-health lever available.
smoke.limitation: Model-based estimate; NOT comparable across PLACES releases.

aggregation.reason: No defensible universe recipe defined; blank when published county value unavailable.

binge.label: Binge Drinking (%)
binge.why_it_matters: Substance-use signal; inputs to behavioral-health capacity planning.
binge.limitation: Self-reported; under-reports in more conservative regions.

aggregation.reason: No defensible universe recipe defined; blank when published county value unavailable.

no_activ.label: No Leisure-Time Physical Activity (%)
no_activ.why_it_matters: Physical-inactivity signal; a large driver of the chronic-disease cluster.

obesity.label: Obesity (%)
obesity.why_it_matters: Population weight status; correlates with the entire cardiometabolic cluster and long-run cost of care.
obesity.limitation: BMI-based; a coarse individual measure that works well at aggregate scale.

aggregation.reason: No defensible universe recipe defined; blank when published county value unavailable.

sleep_lt7.label: Sleeping Less than 7 Hours (%)
sleep_lt7.why_it_matters: Sleep deprivation prevalence; correlates with shift-work density and stress.

aggregation.reason: No defensible universe recipe defined; blank when published county value unavailable.

med_rent.label: Median Gross Rent ($)
med_rent.why_it_matters: Direct market signal for housing investment and rent-burden analysis.
med_rent.limitation: Median is unstable at small denominators.

aggregation.reason: Median gross rent; medians do not aggregate as weighted means of tract rates.

med_home.label: Median Home Value ($)
med_home.why_it_matters: Owner-market signal; input to appraisal comps and LMI-vs-market siting.
med_home.limitation: Self-reported by owner; can lag or lead actual market values.

aggregation.reason: Median home value; medians do not aggregate as weighted means of tract rates.

owner_occ.label: Owner-Occupied Households (%)
owner_occ.why_it_matters: Ownership rate signal; relevant to community stability and lending demand.
owner_occ.limitation: Does not distinguish outright-owned from mortgaged.

renter_occ.label: Renter-Occupied Households (%)
renter_occ.why_it_matters: Rental market share; input to rental-housing investment analysis.
renter_occ.limitation: Complements owner-occupied; not independent of it.

vacant.label: Vacant Housing Units (%)
vacant.why_it_matters: Vacancy signal; combined with population trend informs whether a tract is losing or gaining.
vacant.limitation: Includes seasonal/vacation units; interpret alongside geography.

cost_owner.label: Owners Paying >=30% of Income (%)

universe.label: Owner-occupied housing units with a mortgage where SMOCAPI can be computed (B25091_002E excluding "not computed" B25091_012E)

cost_owner.why_it_matters: Owner cost-burden signal; drives owner-side housing-affordability programming.
cost_owner.limitation: Does not distinguish moderate vs. severe cost burden (30-49% vs 50%+).

cost_rent.label: Renters Paying >=30% of Income (%)

universe.label: Renter-occupied units paying cash rent where GRAPI can be computed (B25070_001E excluding B25070_011E "not computed")

cost_rent.why_it_matters: Rental cost-burden signal; the most common trigger for affordable-housing investment.
cost_rent.limitation: Does not distinguish moderate vs. severe cost burden.

housing_old.label: Housing Built Before 1979 (%)
housing_old.why_it_matters: Proxy for lead-paint risk and rehabilitation-investment opportunity.
housing_old.limitation: Age alone does not indicate condition; a well-maintained older home is not a hazard.

bb_access.label: Households with Broadband Access (%)
bb_access.why_it_matters: Digital-infrastructure signal; drives BEAD program and rural broadband investment analysis.
bb_access.limitation: Self-reported subscription, not measured speed or reliability.

no_intnet.label: Households without Internet Access (%)
no_intnet.why_it_matters: Complements broadband access; captures the fully-disconnected slice.
no_intnet.limitation: Includes households who declined to subscribe as well as those with no service available.

no_veh.label: Households without a Vehicle (%)
no_veh.why_it_matters: Transportation-access signal; a large lever for health, food, and employment access.
no_veh.limitation: Interpreted differently in transit-rich vs. transit-poor tracts.

transit.label: Public Transit Commuters (%)
transit.why_it_matters: Transit demand signal; input to service-planning and TOD analysis.
transit.limitation: Reflects commute mode, not off-peak or intra-region travel.

walk.label: Workers Walking to Work (%)
walk.limitation: Overestimates in college-town tracts and downtown employment cores.

age_65p.label: Population Age 65+ (%)
age_65p.why_it_matters: Aging population share; drives senior-service, home-health, and aging-in-place programming.
age_65p.limitation: Not sensitive to health-status differences within the 65+ population.

age_18_64.label: Population Age 18-64 (%)
age_18_64.why_it_matters: Working-age share; a coarse but useful workforce-availability signal.
age_18_64.limitation: Does not distinguish employed, unemployed, or students.

med_age.label: Median Age
med_age.why_it_matters: Population age structure at a glance; useful for cross-tract comparison.
med_age.limitation: Median compresses bimodal distributions (e.g., a tract with many students AND many retirees).

aggregation.reason: Median age; medians do not aggregate as weighted means of tract rates.

single_p.label: Single-Parent Families (%)
single_p.why_it_matters: Family-structure signal; correlates with childcare and school-based support demand.
single_p.limitation: Does not indicate the presence of extended-family support.

live_alon_65.label: Age 65+ Living Alone (%)
live_alon_65.why_it_matters: Social-isolation signal for the elderly; a leading input to senior-service outreach planning.
live_alon_65.limitation: Household composition alone does not measure social contact.

hh_size.label: Average Household Size
hh_size.why_it_matters: Complements per-capita income; captures family-size structure of a tract.
hh_size.limitation: Group-quarters populations distort in college-town or nursing-home-heavy tracts.

married.label: Married (%)
married.why_it_matters: Family-structure descriptor; correlated with owner-occupancy and household income.
married.limitation: Does not distinguish first vs. remarriage or same-sex vs. opposite-sex couples.

hisp.label: Hispanic (%)
hisp.why_it_matters: DESCRIPTIVE CONTEXT ONLY. This indicator MUST NOT enter any composite score, ranking, or best/worst determination. Fair Lending and Fair Housing exposure — see governance notes.
hisp.limitation: Category not mutually exclusive with racial categories.

black.label: Black / African American (%)
black.why_it_matters: DESCRIPTIVE CONTEXT ONLY. This indicator MUST NOT enter any composite score, ranking, or best/worst determination. Fair Lending and Fair Housing exposure — see governance notes.
black.limitation: Non-Hispanic Black; interpret alongside Hispanic share.

white.label: White (%)
white.why_it_matters: DESCRIPTIVE CONTEXT ONLY. This indicator MUST NOT enter any composite score, ranking, or best/worst determination. Fair Lending and Fair Housing exposure — see governance notes.
white.limitation: Non-Hispanic White; interpret alongside Hispanic share.

asian.label: Asian (%)
asian.why_it_matters: DESCRIPTIVE CONTEXT ONLY. This indicator MUST NOT enter any composite score, ranking, or best/worst determination. Fair Lending and Fair Housing exposure — see governance notes.
asian.limitation: Non-Hispanic Asian; aggregates a heterogeneous set of national origins.

foreign_born.label: Foreign Born Population (%)
foreign_born.why_it_matters: DESCRIPTIVE CONTEXT ONLY. This indicator MUST NOT enter any composite score, ranking, or best/worst determination. Fair Lending and Fair Housing exposure — see governance notes.
foreign_born.limitation: Includes naturalized citizens and non-citizens; does not distinguish immigration status.

lang_span.label: Spanish Speakers (Age 5+) (%)

universe.label: Population 5 years and over (derived: total - under 5)

lang_span.why_it_matters: DESCRIPTIVE CONTEXT ONLY. This indicator MUST NOT enter any composite score, ranking, or best/worst determination. Fair Lending and Fair Housing exposure — see governance notes.
